messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT: embeddings-queue-high-5xx in eu-west-1 detected. PagerDuty triggered. alert_id=eu-embq-6001

pagerbot: PagerDuty: page fired -> oncall: @alex. auto-escalate in 3m if not acknowledged. link: https://pagerduty.example/incident/eu-embq-6001

alex: ack'd. I'm on it — jumping into logs now. status: investigating. :mag:

maria: I can help with customer comms if needed. Which customers are impacted?

priya: seeing ~40% 5xx on embeddings api (POST /v1/embeddings) from eu-west-1. Error log sample: ```2026-03-15T09:01:23Z ERROR kvcache: failed to load kv for shard-3: rpc timeout```

alex: thanks priya. Initial hypothesis: redis-backed KV cache timeouts causing request failures, looks correlated with recent autoscaler churn in that pool. Checking infra metrics.

jess: paging from ops: we had a scheduled node replacement earlier in the window (eu-embed-pool-2). Could be warmup race. Logs show repeated `killed` + `OOM` on pod eu-embed-2b.

alex: rolling restart of embeddings workers underway to force rejoin and warm caches. Command run: ```kubectl rollout restart deployment/embeddings-workers -n infra-eu```

incident-bot: action recorded: alex performed restart command at 2026-03-15T09:05:02Z.

maria: customer impact summary requested. Priya, can you confirm if any enterprise customers hit error budgets?

priya: checked top-10 tenants — two SaaS customers show ~15-25% failed embedding requests for last 8m. No billing-impacting errors yet but retries spike. Ticket created: INC-8472.

alex: hot mitigation: enabling fallback route to replicate embeddings on us-east-1 for affected customers. Patch: update routing policy for customer tags `tier:enterprise` to fallback_region=us-east-1. Running `redwoodctl route update --service embeddings --rule fallback-eu->us-east`

pagerbot: note: cross-region fallback will increase latency for affected requests. Proceed? :warning:

jess: yes proceed. customer-team approved via DM. Doing the routing change now.

sre-runbook-bot: runbook: embeddings degraded -> step 1 verify cache health, step 2 restart workers, step 3 enable fallback routing, step 4 notify customers. Link: https://runbooks.internal/embeddings-degraded

alex: restart finished, healthchecks reporting back. Metrics: 5xx rate dropped from 42% -> 12% in 3m. Still higher than baseline (2%).

priya: routing change applied at 09:11:15Z for customers [cust-ACME, cust-NOVA]. Confirming traffic is now split 70/30 eu->us-east for those tenants.

maria: sending customer update to affected enterprises: short note that we're mitigating, fallback to us-east enabled, expected reduced errors in next 10-15m. Will follow up with postmortem. :envelope_with_arrow:

alex: monitoring heatmap: queue depth back to normal for shards 0-2, shard-3 still shows intermittent spikes. I flagged shard-3 pods for deeper memory diagnostics.

jess: opened a debug pod on node eu-embed-2b, collecting heap profiles and dmesg. Copying results to incident channel when ready.

incident-bot: alert suppressed for eu-embq-6001 at 2026-03-15T09:18:40Z by alex (manual suppress) — reason: mitigation in progress.

priya: update: cust-ACME error rate down to 3%. cust-NOVA down to 6%. Good customer-visible improvement.

alex: plan: keep fallback in place for 30m, continue to monitor shard-3 memory churn, if stable we'll rollback fallback and run controlled restart of node eu-embed-2b overnight.

maria: customer note sent. Also opened a support ticket linking to INC-8472 and assigned to solutions-eng for follow-up.

priya: some anomalies in redis latency — ops is investigating cluster failover logs. Might be partially root cause.

jess: found kernel OOM_killer entries on eu-embed-2b around 08:58Z; quoting `oom_reaper invoked for process embeddings-worker`. Will raise a ticket to infra to investigate node image or cgroup config.

alex: thanks team. handing off to @priya (next oncall) in 12 minutes. Priya, please monitor for 45m and move to postmortem if stabilized. Leaving fallback active until you confirm rollback.

priya: taking ownership. I'll maintain checks and post an update at +30m. :white_check_mark:

maria: note for ops: consider temporarily increasing pod memory request for embeddings-workers in eu pool to reduce OOM risk until we root cause.

sre-runbook-bot: checklist updated: owner=priya, mitigation=fallback to us-east, follow-up=postmortem assigned to alex/jess, infra-ticket=INFRA-2291.

priya: 09:35Z status ping: 5xx rate steady at ~4%. Fallback serving ~18% of traffic for affected tenants. No new customer complaints in last 15m. Will start rollback test at 09:45Z if metrics remain stable.

incident-bot: pagerduty note: oncall reassigned -> owner changed to priya at 2026-03-15T09:36:00Z.

priya: proceeding to rollback test now: will disable fallback for a small subset (cust-NOVA) and observe.

jess: monitoring logs for cust-NOVA now. Initial 5m after rollback show no spike.

priya: rollback looks good for cust-NOVA at +7m. Gradually rollback cust-ACME in next 5m.

alex: filing post-incident action item: investigate autoscaler churn + node image suspicion. Assign to infra and runtime teams.

maria: wrapping up customer comms: follow-up email scheduled with timeline, mitigation, and action items.

priya: final status 09:55Z — traffic normalized, 5xx at baseline (~1.5%). Removing fallback for all customers. Closing incident and moving to postmortem.

incident-bot: incident eu-embq-6001 marked RESOLVED at 2026-03-15T09:56:30Z by priya.

alex: thanks everyone. Good collaboration. I'll add debug artifacts and timeline to the postmortem doc.

maria: thanks team :tada:

priya: closing channel notes and will publish postmortem by EOD.
